title: Admissions Cycle 2022-2023 Overview
content: The new admissions cycle has seen a 5% increase in applications, resulting in a total of 15,000 applicants. The acceptance rate has dropped to 7%, with 1,050 exceptional students admitted. The average SAT score of admitted students is 1480, and the average ACT score is 33. We have students joining us from over 60 countries, making this one of the most diverse cohorts yet.

title: Profiles of Admitted Students
content:
This section contains detailed profiles of students who have been admitted in the current cycle. Each profile includes the student's personal essay, extracurricular achievements, and academic credentials.

Student: Maya Chen
Personal Essay Topic: "The Power of Community Service in Personal Growth"
Extracurricular Achievements: President of the high school Environmental Club, Lead Organizer for the Community Food Drive, Volunteer at the local animal shelter.
Academic Credentials: GPA: 3.98, SAT Score: 1520, AP Courses: Biology, Environmental Science, Calculus AB, and English Literature.

Student: Elijah Rodriguez
Personal Essay Topic: "Overcoming Obstacles: A Journey of Self-Discovery and Resilience"
Extracurricular Achievements: Captain of the varsity soccer team, Founder of the Coding for Kids club, Internship at a software development startup.
Academic Credentials: GPA: 4.0, ACT Score: 34, AP Courses: Computer Science A, Statistics, Physics C, and Spanish Language.

Student: Sarah Johnson
Personal Essay Topic: "Bridging Cultures: My Life as a Third Culture Kid"
Extracurricular Achievements: Editor-in-Chief of the school newspaper, Secretary of the Model United Nations club, Participant in the International Baccalaureate (IB) program.
Academic Credentials: GPA: 3.95, SAT Score: 1490, IB Subjects: History HL, English A Literature HL, Biology HL, and Mathematics SL.

Student: Aiden Smith
Personal Essay Topic: "Innovation and Entrepreneurship: Starting a Non-profit Organization"
Extracurricular Achievements: Founder of TechTeens, a non-profit teaching technology skills to underprivileged youth, Member of the national debate team, Recipient of the Young Innovators Award.
Academic Credentials: GPA: 3.92, SAT Score: 1510, AP Courses: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, English Language, and Calculus BC.

Student: Olivia Kim
Personal Essay Topic: "The Intersection of Art and Science"
Extracurricular Achievements: Lead Violinist in the school orchestra, Science Olympiad team leader, Summer research intern at a neuroscience lab.
Academic Credentials: GPA: 4.0, ACT Score: 35, AP Courses: Chemistry, Physics 1, Studio Art: Drawing, and Music Theory.
